title: DIR-052: Autonomous Self-Healing AI API Server & Zero-Drop Gateway Resilience
spec:
### 1. MANDATE & PROBLEM STATEMENT
The User reports that the local API Server (auto_ai_router.cjs on port 48200 / local_model_service on port 1234) experiences repeated drops, failed startups, and broken connections with Cline. We require an enterprise-grade, zero-crash, self-healing architecture so Cline stays continuously connected to the API server without drops or manual interventions.

### 2. ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA)
1. Missing Process Guards: auto_ai_router.cjs lacks uncaughtException and unhandledRejection handlers. Socket disconnects and ECONNRESET from client or upstream abruptly crash the node process.
2. Unprotected Stream Piping: When streaming chunks from upstream to client, writing to closed or aborted client sockets triggers ERR_STREAM_WRITE_AFTER_END, unlinking the PID file and halting the server.
3. Premature Header Flush: clientRes.writeHead is called before stream verification, preventing failover if the first tokens fail.
4. Passive Daemon Supervision: lead_watcher_daemon.cjs only checks netstat and PID existence rather than active HTTP /health pinging, leaving zombie/hung listeners undetected.
5. LM Studio 10s Re-entry Loop: local_model_service.cjs triggers duplicate lms load calls every 10s while 14B model is still loading, overwhelming VRAM.

### 3. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION & IMPLEMENTATION STEPS
- S1: Process Crash Immunization (auto_ai_router.cjs)
  - Attach process.on('uncaughtException') and process.on('unhandledRejection') to prevent crashes from dropped sockets, client aborts, and transient network resets.
  - Implement reusable HTTP/HTTPS Keep-Alive Agents (keepAlive: true, timeout: 60000).
- S2: Resilient Stream Pipeline & Pre-Header Failover Buffer
  - Buffer initial tokens before flushing HTTP 200 headers to client. If upstream aborts or fails immediately, cleanly failover to next candidate model without dropping client.
  - Guard all clientRes.write calls: verify (!clientRes.destroyed && !clientRes.writableEnded) to prevent ERR_STREAM_WRITE_AFTER_END.
  - Listen for clientReq.on('close') and clientRes.on('error') to gracefully terminate upstream requests.
- S3: Active Health Probing & Auto-Restart in lead_watcher_daemon.cjs
  - Upgrade supervisor to actively probe http://127.0.0.1:48200/health every 5s with 2000ms deadline.
  - If 3 consecutive health checks fail, forcefully kill unresponsive PID, release port 48200, and cleanly respawn the router.
  - Implement exponential backoff restart throttle to prevent CPU thrashing.
- S4: Model Loader Debouncing (local_model_service.cjs)
  - Extend loading state debounce to 90s when loading large models (14B) into GPU.
  - Truncate log spam during model load.
- S5: Comprehensive Self-Test & 50-Request Concurrency Battery
  - Run test script with 50 rapid parallel inference requests and abrupt client terminations to prove zero drops, zero process exits, and instant self-recovery.

### 4. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- AC-1: auto_ai_router.cjs survives 100 consecutive socket drops, aborted requests, and network resets without crashing.
- AC-2: lead_watcher_daemon actively probes /health and auto-recovers any frozen or hung instance in < 6 seconds.
- AC-3: Cline at http://127.0.0.1:48200/v1 achieves 100% connection uptime with zero manual restarts.
- AC-4: All test evidence captured and submitted via bridge dev submit-evidence.

plan.summary: DIR-052 PLAN - Autonomous Self-Healing AI API Server. Read-only RCA verified against live baseline (C:/Users/mbhas/.ai-bridge). RCA-1 PARTIAL: auto_ai_router.cjs now has uncaughtException/unhandledRejection guards + keep-alive httpsAgent, but lacks server clientError guard and keepAliveTimeout/headersTimeout/requestTimeout tuning for long SSE streams. RCA-2 PARTIAL: safeWrite/safeEnd guards + clientReq close cleanup present; needs 100-event battery proof. RCA-3 CONFIRMED: clientRes.writeHead fires at line 437 immediately on upstream 200 before first token (both stream and non-stream), so early upstream aborts cannot failover - pre-header buffer required. RCA-4 PARTIAL: daemon has /health probe + force kill + respawn, but kills on single failed probe (no 3-strike confirm), has NO exponential backoff (315 historical router spawns incl a 12-spawn storm 2026-10-05 21:55-21:56), no port-release wait after kill, no spawn-grace window. RCA-5 CONFIRMED: duplicate lms load re-issued while 14B was at 80-81 pct loading; legacy log grew to 20MB. RCA-6 NEW LIVE FINDING: supervisor daemon PID 36304 and local_model_service PID 38108 are DEAD right now (daemon log stops 06:34:19Z) leaving the system unsupervised, plus a double-spawn race observed (two service instances at 06:34:01/06:34:19) - single-instance guard + scheduled-task watchdog re-enable required. COMPLIANCE: DIR-051 plan explicitly allocated AI-bridge daemons (48200/1234) to DIR-052 self-healing scope, and tests/xampp-policy-guard.test.mjs scans only repo paths - detached respawns in .ai-bridge are pre-authorized, no repo conflict. Deliverables: S1-S2 router hardening + pre-header failover buffer; S3 daemon 3-strike/backoff/port-wait/spawn-mutex + daemon-of-daemon; S4 90s load debounce + log throttle/rotation + single-instance guard; S5 100-event resilience battery (50 parallel + 50 aborts + measured freeze recovery under 6s); S6 live re-mediation; S7-S8 verification + evidence bundle for Gatekeeper certification.
steps: S1: Harden auto_ai_router.cjs - add server.on('clientError') guard, keepAliveTimeout=65000 headersTimeout=66000 requestTimeout=0 for long SSE, clientRes on-close cleanup, preserve existing crash guards

S2: Pre-header failover buffer in handleChatCompletions - streaming validates first SSE data chunk before writeHead, non-stream waits for full body, early upstream abort destroys request and fails over to next candidate via circuit breaker, all client writes via safeWrite/safeEnd

S3: Upgrade lead_watcher_daemon.cjs - 3-consecutive-failure confirmation (2s probe + 2 fast re-probes 500ms apart), taskkill /F /T tree kill, poll port 48200 release up to 3s before respawn, post-spawn health confirm up to 4s with CRASH_RECOVERY_MS telemetry, exponential backoff 5s-60s persisted in lead_watcher_daemon_state.json reset after 5min stable, spawn grace 15s + O_EXCL spawn lock preventing double-spawn, HTTP probe of port 1234 model service

S4: local_model_service.cjs - 90s load debounce persisted in local_model_service_state.json, skip duplicate lms load while load in flight (single throttled waiting log per 30s), single-instance guard exits duplicate loader processes, rotate legacy 20MB log to newest 256KB at startup, log throttle helper

S5: Author test_dir052_resilience.cjs battery - T1 50 parallel mixed stream/non-stream requests asserting HTTP 200 and router PID unchanged (zero exits), T2 50 abrupt client aborts asserting router alive + /health 200 + zero ERR_STREAM_WRITE_AFTER_END, T3 taskkill freeze recovery measuring daemon heal time asserting under 6000ms, T4 single-instance process census, JSON + log evidence to .bridge/evidence

S6: Live remediation - node --check all files, restart fixed daemon via silent VBS, re-enable AIBridge-LeadWatcher-Periodic and -Logon scheduled tasks as daemon-of-daemon watchdog, verify daemon + router + watcher + model service alive, truncate legacy log
S7: Verification - node --test tests/xampp-policy-guard.test.mjs repo guard intact, run resilience battery, capture live /health and /v1/models JSON, npm run test:xampp-policy
S8: Evidence bundle .bridge/evidence/DIR-052-EVIDENCE-SUMMARY.md mapping AC-1..AC-4, submit via bridge dev submit-evidence, await Gatekeeper APPROVED_FROZEN
